title: GOLDEN 40S - The Red Route
creativeIntent: Readable 2D film test with clear screen geography, dialogue portraits, a visible evacuation handoff, departure, and calm space resolution. Use only CURRENT handles and frame-relative composition.

testPlan.purpose: Separate Preview quality from authoring/story quality.
coreChecks: Every beat has meaningful visible content on its first frame
2D screen geography reads without explanatory prose
attacker -> projectile -> target -> impact causality reads
two named dialogue portraits are simultaneously visible
handoff and departure remain readable without oversized icon-like sprites
testPlan.truthRule: Browser motion or VFX timing beyond serialized fields is Preview inference. Unity remains authoritative for runtime materialization.

beats.storyClaim: The last evacuation bus crosses the red route with a ground escort.

actions.subject: mecha
actions.result: Escort and bus continue in one left-to-right direction.

beats.evidence: Mecha foreground-left and bus mid-right are visible from the first frame.

beats.storyClaim: A ground bomb drops over the route while the bus remains visible below.

camera.subject: ground_bomb
camera.purpose: Keep threat and target readable together.

beats.evidence: Bomb begins above the bus and both remain visible.

beats.storyClaim: The escort fires once and intercepts the falling threat.

actions.subject: mecha
actions.result: Projectile crosses to the bomb and impacts it.

beats.evidence: Mecha, threat and bus are simultaneously readable.

beats.storyClaim: A blast erupts behind the convoy, but the bus survives.

actions.subject: mecha
actions.result: Rear explosion blooms while the bus stays readable.

camera.subject: bus
camera.purpose: Keep the survivor as the visual priority.

beats.evidence: Bus remains visible and intact while the blast occurs behind it.

beats.storyClaim: Two pilots make the evacuation decision.

dialogue.speaker: green_pilot
dialogue.text: The road is open. Send the last ship.

beats.evidence: Both portraits are visible from the first frame.

beats.storyClaim: The last bus reaches the waiting command craft.

actions.subject: bus
actions.result: Bus closes the gap toward the visible craft.

camera.subject: command_ship
camera.purpose: Make the destination explicit without an oversized sprite.

beats.evidence: Bus and destination craft share one readable composition.

beats.storyClaim: The command craft departs while the ground escort stays behind.

actions.subject: command_ship
actions.result: Craft rises through frame while ground escort remains as scale reference.

camera.subject: command_ship
camera.purpose: Shift from ground urgency to departure scale.

beats.evidence: Craft and small ground escort are visible together at cut-in.

beats.storyClaim: The surviving command craft clears the surface into open space.

actions.subject: command_ship
actions.result: One small surviving craft drifts steadily into the quiet frame.

camera.subject: command_ship
camera.purpose: End on a calm large environment with one readable survivor.

beats.evidence: The first and final frames contain the surviving craft against open space.
